autoschedule.usage:
Wrong format. Use:
`!autoschedule daily HH:mm your message`
`!autoschedule weekly day HH:mm your message`
autoschedule.day: Invalid day. Use the day's name in English or Arabic, or a number from 0 to 7 (0 and 7 are Sunday).
autoschedule.message: Write the message you want to schedule after the time.
autoschedule.couldNotSchedule: I couldn't schedule that message. Check the time and try again.
schedule.wrongTime: Wrong time format. Use `HH:mm DD-MM-YYYY` (for example `22:30 07-06-2025`).
schedule.pastDate: That date or time is invalid or in the past. Use `HH:mm DD-MM-YYYY` with a future date.
schedule.couldNotSchedule: I couldn't schedule that message. Check the time and try again.
deleteschedule.missingId: Give the ID of the scheduled message to delete. `!listschedules` shows the IDs.
deleteschedule.notFound: ⚠️ No scheduled message has the ID `{id}`
recurrence.errorDayOfMonth: Day of month must be between 1 and 31
